description.zh:
删除所有标签。取值：
- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。

默认取值为**false**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags. Valid values:

- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.

The default value is **false**.
The IDs of the resources. You can specify from **1** to **50** resource IDs.
The type of the resource. The value must be **DOMAIN**.
The keys of the tags to remove. You can specify from **1** to **20** tag keys.

descriptions.en: > The call frequency for a single user is limited to 100 calls per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn untag-dcdn-resources --resource-type DOMAIN --all false --resource-id example000.com --tag-key env --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn UntagDcdnResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'example000.com' --TagKey.1 env --ResourceType DOMAIN
